This bidirectional and non-sequential wiring is best captured by a dependency_graph, which shows the actual call/import structure without imposing pipeline sequencing or hub-and-spoke constraints.

meta.rationale: AnalysisService is a clear orchestrator that drives a defined sequence: TracerClient (extract evidence) → ProfilerClient (build blueprints) → LayoutClient (plan layouts) → RenderClient (generate diagrams). The description explicitly mentions 'full analysis pipeline' with ordered steps. GitHubService and OutputPersister are supporting services that feed into and consume from this main flow.

This module contains a single schema/model component with no runtime edges or dependencies. It serves as a data structure definition for evaluation answer sheets. The zoned approach preserves the module's clean separation, even though there is only one component in the 'other' zone.

This module contains only data models with no orchestration or sequential flow. All components are passive models (tier: secondary) with minimal dependencies (fan_in ≤ 1, fan_out = 0). They naturally group by semantic role: request/input models vs. diagram template models vs. planning models. No dominant pattern emerges, so zoned organization by role is most appropriate.

The module has three distinct zones (tools, business, config) with clear separation of concerns. The business zone contains three independent orchestrators (LayoutService, ViewPlanner, ClusterPlanner) that coordinate different aspects of diagram layout without a single dominant sequential flow. Tools zone provides services and repositories; config zone holds configuration. This is a classic service-oriented architecture best represented as zoned.

The profiler_agent module has a single business zone with a clear orchestrator (ProfilerService) that delegates to a helper service (BlueprintValidator). The orchestrator has moderate fan-out (4) but no runtime edges are defined, indicating independent or loosely-coupled callees. The structure is simple and service-oriented, best represented as a zoned diagram with the orchestrator and its helper grouped by semantic role.

Single-zone module with one primary orchestrator (PlacementService) that has minimal fan-in/fan-out and no runtime edges. The module is a self-contained service with no complex internal delegation or sequential pipeline. Zoned layout preserves clarity for a simple, focused unit.
